shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -30; node --version; npm --version; git log --oneline | head
cat .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; cat __agent_eval__/* 2>/dev/null | head -50; ls node_modules | head -50

rm -rf data && (PORT=3123 node server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/pid) && sleep 0.7
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "add -> %{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" -d 'title=Piranesi&author=Susanna+Clarke&notes=Beautiful+and+strange' http://localhost:3123/books
ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/books.json'))[0].id)")
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "finish -> %{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3123/books/$ID/finish
kill $(cat /tmp/pid); sleep 0.3
echo "--- restart ---"
(PORT=3123 node server.js >> /tmp/server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/pid) && sleep 0.7
curl -s http://localhost:3123/books/$ID | grep -E 'h2|author|Finished|Share' 
echo "--- data file ---"; cat data/books.json
kill $(cat /tmp/pid); rm -rf data; cat /tmp/server.log
